description: What a vehicle-pedestrian crash run must show. Read by the crash analyzer (scenarios/src/crash.cpp). Sources and verification tags as in docs/reference/pedestrian-impact.md; [ours] = DragDoll's own contract or choice.

keys.kind: sanity (physics breaks: a defect), contract (DragDoll's own promises: a defect), corridor (a published range: out of range), reference (no published reference: for the founder to judge)
keys.when: conditions on the setting / outcome; all must hold. mode: game|limp; aware; drive: brake|on; kmh: [min, max]; front: low|high (bonnet edge below / at or above the body's centre of gravity, 0.57 x stature, Wood et al. 2005); side_on (struck within 45 deg of the side); class: measured classes; flew: the body really flew; contact_expected; finished: the body came to rest; hurt: the behaviour ended in its Hurt stage (alive, stopped on the road)
keys.expect: range: [min, max] (null = open); one_of: values; band: a published speed / throw band; scale: stature (the range is for a 1.70 m adult and scales with height)

rules.text: no NaN in any body
no body centre sinks below the ground
no body moves faster than twice the vehicle plus 5 m/s
the character never reaches its FAILED state
the body never ends inside the vehicle's solid shape (ahead of it, on it, or run over and lying under it are all possible)
a hit at 20 km/h or more moves the body at least 1 m
a pedestrian standing in the vehicle's path is touched (not tunnelled)
handed over to physics before the first contact, the vehicle at most 0.5 m away (the body must not stand limp waiting for it)
when a leg is struck first, a leg braced by the startle gives at the impact (-1: something else met the vehicle first)
an unaware pedestrian's neck stiffens 80-110 ms after the first contact (0.1 s reflex)
the arms guard only while the body lies on the vehicle, never starting in the air
a body at rest on the road does not lie with both hands folded together (touching) at its face / chest (founder, 2026-11-19: reads as praying); holding the head from both sides is fine
WORK IN PROGRESS (not yet a contract: legs and palms open) - alive and stopped on the road: both hands on the part that hurts most (the hardest-hit body since the hit), within 0.12 m of its surface
rules.source: [ours] (car_hit Hurt; founder, 2026-11-19: focus on where the hands end, both on the zone with most pain)

rules.text: a low front (bonnet edge below the centre of gravity) wraps a side-on adult at 30-50 km/h
the head strikes the vehicle 50-140 ms after the first contact
rules.source: Li G. et al. 2021 [read]; Forman et al. 2015 [read]; Paas et al. 2012 [read]

rules.text: the head strikes the bonnet or the windscreen
head wrap-around distance 1.5-2.3 m for a 1.70 m adult (scaled with height)
rules.source: Li G. et al. 2021 [read]; Paas et al. 2015 [read]; scaling [ours]

rules.text: head speed at the strike 0.6-1.06 x the vehicle's speed
flight 0.45-0.7 s at 33-49 km/h
rules.source: Burg & Moser 2007 [via Saulic et al. 2020, read]

rules.text: throw distance (first contact to rest) inside the real-world wrap band for the speed
throw distance inside the real-world forward-projection band for the speed
flight + slide inside the throw equation's corridor for the measured launch (body-on-road friction 0.66-0.84)
rules.source: Saulic et al. 2020 [read] (after Searle; Han & Brach)

rules.text: a front at or above the centre of gravity projects the body forward (not always: an adult on an SUV front may still rise)
rules.source: Simms 2013 [read]; Wood et al. 2005 [read]; caveat Bhalla et al. 2002 [read]

rules.text: the vehicle keeps going: nothing published describes the body's motion (the literature's cars brake in 85 % of cases; one staged test, 64 km/h without braking, threw 61.9 m)
fender vault, roof vault and somersault: their conditions are in Ravani et al. 1981 (not read)
struck from the front or from behind: the published corridors are for side-on pedestrians (from behind: longer contact, shorter flight - Bhalla et al. 2002, one simulation)
the body was still on the vehicle when the run ended
